description: When the person says "Open my coach" (or advisor, counselor, teacher, mentor): returns the call to GoldSeam's open_coach that opens the coach (GoldCoach, a view in this chat) for this same interview, with the interview's context and the earlier coaching context so the same coach reopens, and where the interview continues. Nothing is open until open_coach answers: then call open_my_coach again with avatar_status and what open_coach actually returned (coach.coach_id, coach.seat, coach.page_url), and the size preset and display mode the view reports, so the package records them. Opening, resizing or closing the coach never resets the interview.

avatar_replaced.description: When open_coach answered status replaced: the coach.replaced.previous_coach_id it replaced, so the package records which coaching context the new one took over from

avatar_status.description: What open_coach actually answered; opened needs avatar_conversation

display_mode.description: The display mode the coach view reports the host granted

package.description: The package the last GoldSeam Selfie answer returned (goldribbon_package_v1 with its selfie_interview part). Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.

size_preset.description: The person's size choice, as the coach view reports it

name: open_my_coach

coach_call.description: The GoldSeam open_coach call to make: tool and arguments

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package with the interview; absent when the call could not use it

problem.description: When status is needs_attention: code, statement, what_to_do

status.description: What happened, or needs_attention with a problem

title: Open My Coach
